## 7. JOINT ACCOUNT PROVISIONS  
### 7.1 Joint & Several Liability  
For joint accounts:
- **Both Signatories Liable:** Either account holder can withdraw full balance
- **Interest Split:** Shared equally (unless you specify otherwise)
- **Disputes:** Both must agree to account closure

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Arrangement
raw_entities.description: A joint account arrangement where both signatories hold equal liability and rights. Either account holder can withdraw the full balance, and interest is shared equally unless otherwise specified by the account holders.
context: For joint accounts: Both Signatories Liable: Either account holder can withdraw full balance
Interest Split: Shared equally (unless you specify otherwise)
Both must agree to account closure

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Signatory Liability Clause
raw_entities.description: A contractual provision establishing that both signatories on a joint account are jointly and severally liable, meaning either account holder can withdraw the full balance without consent of the other.
context: Both Signatories Liable: Either account holder can withdraw full balance
For joint accounts

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Interest Distribution Rule
raw_entities.description: A contractual provision governing how interest accrued on a joint account is distributed between account holders. Interest is shared equally by default unless the account holders specify an alternative arrangement.
context: Interest Split: Shared equally (unless you specify otherwise)

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Closure Consent Requirement
raw_entities.description: A contractual provision requiring that both account holders must agree before a joint account can be closed. This protects the rights of both signatories by preventing unilateral account termination.
context: Disputes: Both must agree to account closure

raw_entities.description: A person with legal rights and obligations as a signatory on a joint account. Each joint signatory can withdraw the full balance and shares equally in accrued interest unless otherwise specified.
